name: authenticated_worker_startup

test_list.description: Admission is retired before cancellation or known failure starts process cleanup, and the fallback drop guard retires at most once.
A platform stop that never resolves must reach its cleanup deadline, retire the generation and retain its force-stop backstop before supervisor abort.
Initialize each generation before probing health; retire every completed generation.
A failed initializer cannot publish a healthy process or detach its tree.
Startup deadline and caller shutdown preserve the process stop guard and retire the generation.
An unconfirmed OS cleanup halts automatic replacement, retaining emergency stop ownership.
The explicit bootstrap copy remains wrapped in a zeroizing secret and authenticates the same parent-issued identity.

inputs.name: worker
inputs.description: Owned executable, explicit environment, restart and deadline policy.

output_description: A supervised process initialized before health monitoring, with generation retirement and process ownership across failure and cancellation.
